name: Meridith's Love Letter
summary: Meridith's Love Letter carries a message from Meridith to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris. It is a small plea born from a meeting after a flying machine crashed.

sections.title: A Message for Narain
sections.body: After rescuing Narain Soothfancy from a crashed flying machine, Meridith asks you to carry her letter to him. She has fallen in love with the gnome and hopes he will hear her feelings.

sections.title: Narain's Reply
sections.body: Narain recoils when he learns who sent the letter. Meridith is a fish, he protests, and he is a gnome; he sees no way their love could work.

faq.answer: Meridith wrote the letter for Narain Soothfancy, the gnome she rescued from a crashed flying machine.
The letter is for Narain Soothfancy, a gnome in Tanaris.

faq.q: Why does Meridith send a letter?
faq.answer: Meridith believes she has fallen in love with Narain and wants him to know how she feels.
Meridith rescued Narain from the wreckage of a crashed flying machine.

faq.q: What does Narain say about the letter?
faq.answer: Narain says Meridith is a fish and he is a gnome, so he believes they could never be together.

angles.text: As a gnome, you carry Meridith's feelings to Narain Soothfancy, a fellow gnome who is startled by her message.
